operationalFindings.finding: A legacy error handler logged the full failing request including headers, which put a live API key into a log table.
operationalFindings.rule: Redact credentials at the transport layer, never log request headers.

operationalFindings.finding: Orders deleted upstream return 404 forever, and a checker retried them in a loop.
operationalFindings.rule: Retry only what is the API talking about its own problems: 429, 5xx and timeouts. Surface a 404 on a known record as a typed deleted-upstream error so callers reconcile instead of retrying.
